dataset_metadata.not_olivetti: This release is 92x112 PGM. It is not the Olivetti 64x64 matrix used by load_dataset('ORL').
dataset_metadata.orientation: PGM header width 92, height 112. Saved native array is (400, 112, 92): axis 1 is file row (height), axis 2 is file column (width). No transpose was applied.
preprocessing_operations: read AT&T PGM files in subject directory s1..s40 and image name 1.pgm..10.pgm
resize each uint8 image to 32x32 with PIL bilinear
dataset_metadata.sample_selection_method: all 400 PGM images; label = subject number minus 1
